I called the clinic, and their assistant responded, saying they hadn't touched the adjacent tooth. I'm very confused; if they hadn't touched it, how could food get stuck there and cause sensitivity? I didn't expect the clinic to respond like that. I'm very disappointed.

Regarding the clinic's response: They called after I had already made an appointment elsewhere and requested to reschedule for next Wednesday. I've started experiencing pain in the tooth that was drilled, so I'm going to another clinic today to have it checked.

Update: A depression was indeed created, and my old filling fell out and needs to be replaced.
